tracking: ADR-0303 (lane L11, P18 C6): API-only SIEM destination routes; the admin screen is posted on #453

gaps.GET /v1/siem/destinations: lists SIEM destinations, their state, cursor and lag (never the secret)
gaps.POST /v1/siem/destinations: creates a SIEM destination, off by default; the Standard Webhooks secret is shown once
gaps.PUT /v1/siem/destinations/:destinationId: turns a SIEM destination on (step-up, audited as a relaxation) or off (audited)
gaps.POST /v1/siem/destinations/:destinationI: rotates a SIEM destination's signing secret, shown once (step-up, audited)
returns a dead-lettered or backing-off SIEM destination to delivery now (audited)
